title: Release Notes: Ramp (+ cash bonus), IRS EIN tracker, and more perks
summary: Ramp joined our ecosystem of banking platforms (+ cash bonus), we made the first IRS EIN processing time tracker, plus even more new and updated perks. Get the full details in our May release notes.
body_markdown:
Here's what's new:


#### You can now open a Ramp account and get a cash bonus


[Ramp](https://www.clerky.com/blog/ramp) has joined our[ecosystem of banking platforms](https://help.clerky.com/article/2971-can-clerky-help-with-banking#available-options) . You can now start an application through Clerky in just one click and get[up to $1,750 in bonuses](https://x.com/clerkyinc/status/2046997580241125687) : $1,000 after a $25k Ramp Treasury deposit, plus $750 after your first $1k balance payment (both within 90 days).


#### IRS EIN processing time tracker for non-US founders


Non-US founders and others applying for an EIN by fax can now[check live IRS processing times on Clerky](https://www.clerky.com/irs-ein-processing-times) . Our auto-updating status page shows projections based on the applications we process in-house, providing you the most accurate estimate available.


#### New and updated perks


- [Google Workspace](https://x.com/clerkyinc/status/2014035344476479666) — 20% off for the first 6 months
- [Inkle](https://x.com/clerkyinc/status/2019110941028438472) — Updated: 25% off bookkeeping for 6 months, plus free FBAR, Form 7004, and Form 1099 filings when you subscribe to Inkle Tax Standard and use Inkle to file Form 1120
- [Xero](https://x.com/clerkyinc/status/2041924059248914575) — 6 months free


You can view these perks by going to **Perks** for your team.
